# Habit material fixture

`observations.doc` is an original, small Word 97–2004 binary document containing
only this fictional test sentence:

> 每日读一页书，记录一项观察，整理桌面。

It was generated once from UTF-8 text using macOS `textutil -convert doc`.
Tests read this committed binary directly; running the app or tests does not
require macOS, Microsoft Word, LibreOffice, or textutil.

DOCX and PDF samples (including a Chinese PDF ToUnicode map) are generated by
`test/habit-material-fixtures.js` without external programs or downloads.
